question: Under what optimized transesterification conditions (catalyst amount, methanol/oil ratio, temperature, time) was the maximum biodiesel yield obtained?
rendered: The maximum biodiesel yield of 98.74% was obtained under the optimized transesterification conditions of 30 mg of the GO-Gd2TiO5/g-C3N4 catalyst, a methanol-to-oil ratio of 12 : 1, a temperature of 65 °C, and a reaction time of 210 minutes.
